beforeDue: Corrected age: due date not yet reached
dueToday: Today is the estimated due date
afterDue: {n} days past the estimated due date
milestoneNote: CDC: examples of skills at least 75% of children show by this age. Not an individual assessment.
developmentNote: Missing milestones, lost skills or concerns? Talk with your child’s doctor.
pregnancyNote: General guidance; size and development vary. Keep your antenatal appointments.
movementNote: Reduced or changed movements? Contact your midwife or maternity unit immediately.
earlyText: Pregnancy weeks count from the first day of the last period, usually about two weeks before fertilisation.
earlyTip: Enter the estimated due date agreed with your care team.
tipEarly: Write down questions for your next appointment and make time for rest.
tipMiddle: A quiet moment of talking or singing can become a shared ritual.
tipLate: Plan who can help with meals and everyday tasks after the birth.
setup: Enter the estimated due date or the actual birth date in settings.
invalidReference: Enter a valid preview date or leave the field empty.
invalidDue: Enter a valid estimated due date.
futureBirth: The birth date is in the future. Use the estimated due date before birth.
dueTooFar: The due date is more than 280 days away. Please check the date.
confirmBirth: The due date was at least two weeks ago. Check it or enter the actual birth date after birth.
beyondRange: These cards cover pregnancy and children up to and including age five.
invalidCorrection: Enter a whole number from 0 to 20 weeks for age correction.
loadError: The baby content could not be loaded.
